summary: The GitHub Code Quality upload-code-coverage action now checks that your coverage report is in Cobertura XML format. If it isn’t in a supported format, the upload step fails and the Actions log shows this error: This file is not a Cobertura XML report.
takeaways: To use code coverage, you need GitHub Code Quality enabled for your repository.
Learn more about setting up code coverage for your repository on GitHub Enterprise Cloud .
